mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses risk-free rates, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past three months.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized inflation (computed from CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is declining (indicating monetary easing) and the unemployment rate is falling (indicating a strengthening labor market), the combined signal signals a strong economic recovery, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decline > 0.1% and UNRATE decline > 0.1% in the last month
regime_hint: monetary easing with labor market strength
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decline > 0.1% and UNRATE decline > 0.1% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by UNRATE < 5% and HOUST > 900), the economy is approaching a peak, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5% and HOUST > 900.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (indicating a weakening labor market) compresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE has risen in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 0.5% in the last month, it signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decline > 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decline > 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: When residential fixed investment (RSAFS) is declining (indicating a weakening housing market) and the federal funds rate is rising (indicating monetary tightening), the combined signal indicates a high risk of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decline > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS rise > 0.1% in the last month
regime_hint: housing market weakness with monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS decline > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS rise > 0.1% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by CPIAUCSL > 2% and FEDFUNDS > 1%), the Federal Reserve's policy is restrictive, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2% and FEDFUNDS > 1%.
